questions.q: Which pair describes shape and form correctly?
options: Shape is 3D and form is flat
Shape is flat and form is three-dimensional
questions.why: Shape is a 2D area; form is 3D or made to look 3D.

questions.q: Building tone with crossing parallel lines is called:
questions.why: Cross-hatching uses sets of lines crossing at angles to build darker tone.

questions.q: Which is an example of actual (real) texture?
questions.why: Impasto can be felt; hatching only implies texture.
